scope: Functional explicit input-only DXF Compatible/ExactNamed reader API, original raw declaration selection, owned read-entry policy/cumulative mapping observations and consumer contract. No adapter/CLI exact-input selection or producer/native qualification.

behavior.policySnapshot: Admitted file/non-null memory reads snapshot before reader construction/callbacks. Early file failure exposes requested snapshot with no invented decode events. Persistent callback mutation affects only a later read.
behavior.observations: Appended codePagePolicy/exactNamedDecodeCalls/unavailableNamedDecodeCalls preserve older aggregate prefixes. Counters overlap, count semantic calls, saturate and survive reader teardown/returned failure/reuse as owned snapshots.
behavior.rawDeclaration: ExactNamed resolves full physical HEADER group3, not decoded/deleted metadata or normalized output label. Reapplication preserves original exact resolution.
behavior.exactMapping: Available exact input decoder is selected lazily; ISO8859-4 compact/hyphen names deliver independently anchored U+0104/U+0138/U+02D9.
behavior.unavailable: Unknown/unimplemented high-byte fields preserve ASCII lexemes and replace each uninterpretable high byte with U+FFFD, observing UnavailableCodePage/ReplacedSource. Mixed-field escapes are not guessed through unknown multibyte grammar. ASCII-only represented CIF/MIF can be decoder-independent.
noninterference: Modern DXF uses existing UTF8 independently of legacy metadata.
DWG/non-DXF byte channels and fromUtf8 output codec remain unchanged.
Actual eligible CP1252 explicit LibreCAD UTF8 recovery remains independent; ISO compatibility fallback does not become recovery.
Raw carriers, tolerant read Boolean/error policy and default library/adapter/CLI behavior remain unchanged.
Legacy UTF8/UTF16 decoder availability does not admit unsupported DXF Unicode wire interpretation.
behavior.lifetime: Writes/rejected nesting/null-interface memory reads preserve last-read observations. Swap/move own policy/resolution/cache without borrowing source declaration strings.
